explanation: Place one queen in each row, rejecting columns and diagonals already occupied. Backtrack after exploring each safe placement, and copy every complete column sequence into the result.
timeComplexity: O(n × n! + nS), where S is the number of solutions
spaceComplexity: O(n) working space, plus O(nS) output
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
